Ukraine Accuses SpaceX of Limiting Starlink, Disrupting Military Operations

Ukraine has accused Elon Musk's SpaceX of limiting its Starlink internet services, which the country claims is undermining its ability to defend itself from Russia. This comes as Ukraine reported intense drone and ballistic missile attacks, stating they occurred without usual advance warning from allies. Russia, meanwhile, claimed it hit a ship delivering military cargo to Mykolaiv and that it continues to work with Kyiv and Moscow to end the war. Other reports indicated heavy Russian strikes on Ukraine killed at least six people and cut power in Kyiv, while also destroying a block of flats. India has urged Russia and Ukraine to protect Black Sea shipping, citing risks to Indian seafarers.
